messages:
alyssa: Starting canary rollout for rwd-infer v2.3.1 -> eu-west-1 (5% traffic). tagging @deploybot. If 5xx > 1% for 5m we should hit the backout play. runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/backout-cross-region-v1

deploybot: deploybot: canary started (id: canary-2380001234). Observability hooks enabled.

maria: watching dashboards now — will call if anything crosses threshold.

dimitri: seeing 0.7% 5xx on long-seq paths, p95 jumps. looks like KV cache misses for sequence lengths > 1024. no config changes from infra side?

alyssa: no config changes. We did flip quantize=true for the variant though. Could be regressions in operator kernels. Hold pattern: watch for spike >1%.

maria: noted. prepping escape hatch: pin command + traffic reroute + cache warm. pin target = 2.3.0. runbook snippet: "Abort canary -> infra pin -> re-run cache-warm -> monitor 10m"

sam: pin command ready: `infra pin-version --model rwd-infer --version 2.3.0 --reason "canary error spike"`

deploybot: metrics update: 5m window: 1.9% 5xx (threshold 1%). Recommendation: trigger backout. See runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/backout-cross-region-v1#steps

alyssa: I'm going to trigger the backout now. Plan: 1) abort canary in deploy service 2) run sam's pin command 3) ensure routing disables v2.3.1 variant 4) run cache-warm job for 2.3.0 5) notify SRE & CS. Anyone object?

oncall: running pin now. executing: `infra pin-version --model rwd-infer --version 2.3.0 --reason "automated backout"`

oncall: infra pin log -> SUCCESS. traffic rolled back to 2.3.0 for eu-west-1 canary cohort.

maria: starting cache-warm job (warm-job id: warm-7721). will post when done.

dimitri: watch traces for long-seq paths; routing errors dropped after pin. p95 back down to baseline in first checks.

ops-runbook-bot: Backout checklist executed. steps_completed=[abort_canary, pin_version, routing_revert, cache_warm_started]. rollback_success=true. postmortem_required=yes. incident_channel=#inc-2380.

maria: cache-warm finished. verifying tokenization and KV hit rates — looks stable.

alyssa: thanks everyone. I'll open a ticket for model/quant team to investigate quantization kernel mismatch and include failing traces: https://issues.redwood.com/2380

sam: opened PR to revert the canary flip on main and added release note entry: "v2.3.1 canary halted due to 5xx spike; pinned to 2.3.0; follow-up investigation ongoing." PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwd-deploys/pull/456

dimitri: thumbs up. we should also add automated regression test for long-seq KV behavior to the CI.

alyssa: agreed. Next steps: 1) schedule postmortem meeting, 2) collect canary traces and replay logs, 3) coordinate with quant team for patch. i'll update incident channel when meeting is scheduled. :thumbsup:

maria: noted. closing this thread once postmortem invite is sent. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: deploybot: canary aborted (id: canary-2380001234). rollback complete.
